title: MedEvo: Medical Reasoning Evolution through Knowledge Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17690v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical multimodal reasoning models are typically trained on teacher-generated rationales, discarding the valid reasoning in students' own failed trajectories, while general-domain correction methods offer little guidance for errors in image reading, anatomical context, or differential diagnosis. We propose MedEvo, which uses medical knowledge, namely a tag taxonomy and error-type diagnosis, to navigate both trajectory repair and data selection. For each failed rollout, a gold-blind auditor locates the first consequential error and provides a minimal, answer-free hint; the same student retains the valid prefix and regenerates the erroneous suffix. After each round, MedEvo identifies capability gaps across medical tags on a held-out feedback set and prioritizes related questions for new rollouts and repairs. translated_title: MedEvo：通过知识导航实现医学推理的演化
translated_abstract: 医学多模态推理模型通常在教师生成的推理依据上进行训练，这丢弃了学生模型自身失败轨迹中蕴含的有效推理内容，而通用领域的纠错方法对于图像读取、解剖学背景或鉴别诊断中的错误几乎没有指导意义。我们提出MedEvo，利用医学知识——即标签分类体系和错误类型诊断——来引导轨迹修复和数据选择。对于每个失败的生成轨迹，一个不接触标准答案的审计器会定位第一个关键错误，并给出最小的、不含答案的提示；同一学生模型保留有效的推理前缀，并重新生成错误的后缀部分。每一轮之后，MedEvo在一个留出的反馈集上识别跨医学标签的能力缺口，并优先选取相关问题用于新一轮的轨迹生成与修复。仅通过监督微调（SFT），MedEvo就将Qwen3.5-9B在七个基准测试上的平均准确率从65.57%提升至69.12%（47.40……
tldr: MedEvo利用医学标签分类体系和错误类型诊断来引导失败轨迹的修复与训练数据选择，仅通过监督微调就将医学多模态推理模型在七个基准上的平均准确率从65.57%提升至69.12%。
en_tdlr: MedEvo leverages medical knowledge—a tag taxonomy and error-type diagnosis—to navigate trajectory repair and data selection, raising Qwen3.5-9B's mean accuracy across seven benchmarks from 65.57% to 69.12% with supervised fine-tuning alone.
